attribution.note: Marcus states his own assessment and endorses the reliability concern.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the reliability concern and tentative corroboration from ROI studies. The tentative connection is not scorable under the policy.

contract.note: The contract operationalizes a tentative connection despite the rule excluding hedged claims. Its current-year restriction also excludes older studies without a period supplied by Marcus.

evidence.note: The dated controlled preprint supports reliability problems in long workflows. It does not measure enterprise returns or connect failures to ROI.

This commissioned survey disclosure partially supports practical reliability concerns. Its 1,000 leaders reported deployment barriers; data and infrastructure explanations prevent isolating LLM reliability or its effect on net returns.

The publisher reports both zero and substantial Copilot returns and alternative barriers. Undisclosed fieldwork dates limit period matching; successful deployments do not refute the existence of reliability problems.
The dated survey disclosure supplies relevant organizational context. Broad AI revenue and productivity gains cannot establish LLM net ROI or contradict reliability failures.

reviews.rationale: Marcus presents the ROI-to-reliability connection tentatively, so the combined proposition is not scorable under the policy. Evidence supports reliability limitations, but the packet does not establish several studies connecting those limitations to realized return shortfalls. Positive-return reports do not directly contradict his concern.
